Method of Attack: Malware campaigns abusing Excel 4.0 (XLM) macros to evade static analysis and infect targets
Using XLM macros to call Win32 APIs and run shell commands
Deploying malware payloads via Office document macros including VBA, PowerShell, JScript, VBScript, MSHTA/Jscript9, WMI, or .NET code
Attack Vector: Malicious Office document macros (XLM macros, VBA macros)
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious XLM macros detected via AMSI integration in Office 365 apps
